# datasintef Provider

Interact with the DataSintef API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "datasintef" {
  environment = "dev"

  # client_id     = "your-client-id"      # or set DATASINTEF_CLIENT_ID env var
  # client_secret = "your-client-secret"   # or set DATASINTEF_CLIENT_SECRET env var
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token (JWT) for local development. Obtain from the browser after logging in. May also be provided via DATASINTEF_BEARER_TOKEN environment variable. Mutually exclusive with client_id/client_secret.
- `client_id` (String) OAuth2 client ID for machine authentication. May also be provided via DATASINTEF_CLIENT_ID environment variable.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OAuth2 client secret for machine authentication. May also be provided via DATASINTEF_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable.
- `environment` (String) Target environment: 'dev', 'stg', or 'prod'. Determines API URL, tenant, and auth endpoints. Defaults to 'dev'. May also be provided via DATASINTEF_ENVIRONMENT environment variable.
- `host` (String) URI for the DataSintef API. Overrides the URL from the environment setting. May also be provided via DATASINTEF_HOST environment variable.
